'''Opeli Mors''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the newly formed [[Jin'ri trade syndicate]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. In [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], she served as the syndicate's representative at a meeting concerning the formation of a [[Great River|network]] to facilitate [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] movement and to aid [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] across the war-torn regions of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Held aboard [[Shelter]] station, the meeting was attended by [[Hutt underground|Hutt underground]] representative [[Bana Besadii Diori]], [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]] [[New Plympto resistance (Yuuzhan Vong War)|resistance]] member [[Numa Rar]], Shelter owner [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], and members of the [[Solo family/Legends|Solo family]]: [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] and [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]]. During the discussions, Mors defended the syndicate's business practices after Leia accused it of exploiting war refugees, offered the syndicate's services in exchange for payment, and offered the loan of a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] at no charge as a goodwill investment in the project.

==Biography==
{{Quote|We are a relatively new concern. We formed to meet the needs of refugees soon after the fall of Duro. We welcome the opportunity to expand.|Opeli Mors|<ref name="Rebirth" />}}
Opeli Mors was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] and a member of the [[Jin'ri trade syndicate]], a newly formed group of war profiteers established after the [[Battle_of_Duro_(Yuuzhan_Vong_War)|fall]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]&mdash;a conflict fought between the extragalactic [[Yuuzhan Vong]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]&mdash;to meet the needs of the displaced [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]].<ref name="Rebirth" /> 

[[File:LandoJapan.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Lando Calrissian invited Mors to the meeting.]]
In [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]'' to [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]].</ref> Mors represented the syndicate at a meeting on [[Shelter]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]] and owned by the businessman [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], to discuss the formation of the [[Great River]], a network conceived by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to aid refugees across war-torn regions of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] while facilitating the movement of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in and out of occupied systems. Also in attendance were [[Bana Besadii Diori]] of the [[Hutt underground]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Numa Rar]] of the [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]] [[New Plympto resistance (Yuuzhan Vong War)|resistance]], and members of the [[Solo family/Legends|Solo family]]: [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] and [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]].<ref name="Rebirth" />

During the meeting, Mors defended the Jin'ri trade syndicate after Leia accused it of exploiting war refugees for profit. Although she personally supported the Great River initiative and wished to aid the fight against the Yuuzhan Vong,<ref name="Rebirth" /> Mors also recognized the commercial opportunities the network presented for the syndicate through the sale of supplies.<ref name="TCSWE: Mors, Opeli">{{CSWECite|II|332|Mors, Opeli}}</ref> She explained that any substantial assistance required authorization first from her superiors, but announced that the syndicate had approved the loan of a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] at no charge as an investment in the network.<ref name="Rebirth" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I came here in good faith.|Opeli Mors|<ref name="Rebirth" />}}
[[File:Han-rebelstand.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Han Solo and Leia Organa, whom Opeli Mors admired.]]
Opeli Mors had a business-like personality and remained composed during heated negotiations, calmly responding to Leia Organa Solo's accusations that the Jin'ri trade syndicate was exploiting war refugees.<ref name="Rebirth" /> Her feminine first name, "Opeli," and her surname, "Mors," were both of Human origin.<ref name="gcg">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> Mors was a [[Color/Legends|dark]]-skinned woman<ref name="Rebirth" /> with a severe appearance and believed that the syndicate provided necessary services at fair prices, defending its profit-driven practices. She eagerly sought the opportunity to work with Leia and Han, having grown up hearing about their exploits against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and she sincerely wanted to support their fight against the Yuuzhan Vong.<ref name="njo">''[[The New Jedi Order Sourcebook]]''</ref> 

Mors was personally willing to provide the Jedi with whatever assistance they needed, but was constrained by her superiors, who required her to obtain authorization before committing the syndicate's resources. Nevertheless, Mors demonstrated a willingness to support the Jedi despite these business considerations,<ref name="njo" /> providing a [[YT-1930 transport/Legends|YT-1930]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] on loan at no charge as a gesture of good faith.<ref name="njo" />

==Skills and abilities==
Opeli Mors was an experienced negotiator and businesswoman, possessing strong skills in diplomacy, gathering information, appraisal, and knowledge of business and streetwise practices. She was also adept at bluffing and reading the motives of others, allowing her to navigate negotiations and commercial dealings effectively. Mors was proficient in [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]], [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]], and [[Computer/Legends|computer]] use, and could operate and navigate starships. She was fluent in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] and [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] and was literate in both languages.<ref name="njo" />

==Equipment==
Mors was equipped with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and was provided with a YT-1930 transport by the Jin'ri trade syndicate to loan to the Jedi network.<ref name="njo" />

==Behind the scenes==
Opeli Mors first appeared in [[2001]] in ''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]'', the second novel in [[Greg Keyes]]'s ''[[Edge of Victory Duology]]'', and the eight novel in the ''[[Star Wars: The New Jedi Order]]'' series.<ref name="Rebirth" />
